name: format_add_error
doc: 加法舍入误差：`|round (a + b) − (a + b)| ≤ eps·|a + b| + tiny`。
stmt:
theorem format_add_error (F : FloatFormat) (r : RoundOp F) (a b : ℝ) :
    |roundToFormat F r (a + b) - (a + b)| ≤ F.eps * |a + b| + F.tiny
proof: r.err_bound (a + b)

name: format_mul_error
doc: 乘法舍入误差：`|round (a · b) − a · b| ≤ eps·|a · b| + tiny`。
stmt:
theorem format_mul_error (F : FloatFormat) (r : RoundOp F) (a b : ℝ) :
    |roundToFormat F r (a * b) - a * b| ≤ F.eps * |a * b| + F.tiny
proof: r.err_bound (a * b)

name: format_error_bound_of_le
doc:
有界输入的舍入误差界：`|x| ≤ M`（`M ≥ 0`）⟹ `|round x − x| ≤ eps·M + tiny`
（把相对项 `eps·|x|` 用输入界 `M` 换掉，供逐元素一致估计使用）。
proof:
by
  refine le_trans (r.err_bound x) ?_
  exact add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx F.eps_nonneg) F.tiny

name: round_preserves_zero
doc:
零的舍入：`tiny = 0` 时 `round 0 = 0`
（误差界在 `x = 0` 处给出 `|round 0| ≤ 0`）。
stmt:
theorem round_preserves_zero (F : FloatFormat) (r : RoundOp F) (h : F.tiny = 0) :
    roundToFormat F r 0 = 0
proof:
by
  have hb := r.err_bound 0
  rw [h] at hb
  simp at hb
  simpa [roundToFormat] using hb

name: op_error_chain
doc:
**两段运算链的误差传播**：`f` 为 `κ`-Lipschitz、`g` 为 `λ`-Lipschitz
（`κ, λ ≥ 0`），舍入发生在 `f` 的输入 ⟹
`|g (f (round x)) − g (f x)| ≤ λ·κ·(eps·|x| + tiny)`
（误差沿链按各环节 Lipschitz 常数相乘累积 = 链的条件数）。
stmt:
theorem op_error_chain (F : FloatFormat) (r : RoundOp F) (f g : ℝ → ℝ)
    (κ lam x : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (hlam : 0 ≤ lam)
    (hf : ∀ x y : ℝ, |f x - f y| ≤ κ * |x - y|)
    (hg : ∀ x y : ℝ, |g x - g y| ≤ lam * |x - y|) :
    |g (f (roundToFormat F r x)) - g (f x)| ≤ lam * κ * (F.eps * |x| + F.tiny)
proof:
by
  have h2 : |f (roundToFormat F r x) - f x| ≤ κ * (F.eps * |x| + F.tiny) :=
    op_error_propagation F r f κ x hκ hf
  calc
    |g (f (roundToFormat F r x)) - g (f x)| ≤ lam * |f (roundToFormat F r x) - f x| := hg _ _
    _ ≤ lam * (κ * (F.eps * |x| + F.tiny)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hlam
    _ = lam * κ * (F.eps * |x| + F.tiny) := by ring

name: op_error_chain_iterate
doc:
运算链的逐层形式：`n` 层 `κ`-Lipschitz 算子复合的舍入误差 ≤ `κⁿ·(eps·|x| + tiny)`
（`Function.iterate` 形式的链，`κ ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
theorem op_error_chain_iterate (F : FloatFormat) (r : RoundOp F) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (κ x : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hf : ∀ x y : ℝ, |f x - f y| ≤ κ * |x - y|) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, |(f^[n]) (roundToFormat F r x) - (f^[n]) x| ≤ κ ^ n * (F.eps * |x| + F.tiny)
proof:
by
  have hbase : 0 ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny :=
    add_nonneg (mul_nonneg F.eps_nonneg (abs_nonneg x)) F.tiny_nonneg
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      rw [Function.iterate_zero_apply, Function.iterate_zero_apply, pow_zero, one_mul]
      exact r.err_bound x
  | succ n ih =>
      calc
        |(f^[n + 1]) (roundToFormat F r x) - (f^[n + 1]) x|
            = |f ((f^[n]) (roundToFormat F r x)) - f ((f^[n]) x)| := by
              rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.iterate_succ_apply']
        _ ≤ κ * |(f^[n]) (roundToFormat F r x) - (f^[n]) x| := hf _ _
        _ ≤ κ * (κ ^ n * (F.eps * |x| + F.tiny)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih hκ
        _ = κ ^ (n + 1) * (F.eps * |x| + F.tiny) := by ring

                 
                                                             
                                        
                                        
                                                            
                                                  
                
                                                                      
                                               
                                               
                                                   
                         

end Lattice

proof: R.sign_preserve_neg x h

name: ieee_round_zero
doc: **零的舍入**：`round 0 = 0`（由两侧符号保持夹出）。
stmt:

    R.toFun 0 = 0
proof: le_antisymm (R.sign_preserve_neg 0 le_rfl) (R.sign_preserve_pos 0 le_rfl)

name: ieee_round_fixed_point
doc: **幂等是单调意义下的「落在格点上」**：舍入结果的再舍入不变。
stmt:
theorem ieee_round_fixed_point (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F m) (x : ℝ) :
    R.toFun (R.toFun x) = R.toFun x
proof: R.idem x

name: ieee_relative_error_bound
doc:
**相对误差界**：在正规范围（`tiny ≤ eps·|x|`）且 `0 < |x|` 时，
`|round x − x| ≤ 2·eps·|x|`。
**诚实标注**：常数 `2` 而非 `1`，因为本文件把绝对底 `tiny` 直接吸收进相对项
（`tiny ≤ eps·|x|` 时 `eps|x| + tiny ≤ 2·eps|x|`）；若要常数 1 需更强的「最近偶数」语义。
proof:
by
  have h1 : |R.toFun x - x| ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny := R.err_bound x
  have h2 : F.tiny ≤ F.eps * |x| := hr
  calc
    |R.toFun x - x| ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny := h1
    _ ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.eps * |x| := by linarith
    _ = 2 * F.eps * |x| := by ring

name: ieee_error_bound_of_le
doc:
有界输入的舍入误差界：`|x| ≤ Mn ⟹ |round x − x| ≤ eps·Mn + tiny`
（与 `RealFloatFormat.format_error_bound_of_le` 同形，此处经 IEEE 语义表述）。
stmt:
theorem ieee_error_bound_of_le (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F m) {x Mn : ℝ}
    (hx : |x| ≤ Mn) : |R.toFun x - x| ≤ F.eps * Mn + F.tiny
proof:
by
  refine le_trans (R.err_bound x) ?_
  exact add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx F.eps_nonneg) F.tiny

name: ieee_subnormal_abs_bound
doc: **次正规区绝对值不增**：`|x| ≤ tiny ⟹ |round x| ≤ tiny`。
stmt:
theorem ieee_subnormal_abs_bound (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F m) {x : ℝ}
    (h : BelowTiny F x) : |R.toFun x| ≤ F.tiny
proof: R.subnormal_bound x h

name: ieee_subnormal_error_le
doc:
**次正规区误差被绝对底支配**：`|x| ≤ tiny ⟹ |round x − x| ≤ 2·tiny`
（相对界在此失效，只剩不可约的绝对底）。
stmt:
theorem ieee_subnormal_error_le (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F m) {x : ℝ}
    (h : BelowTiny F x) : |R.toFun x - x| ≤ 2 * F.tiny
proof:
by
  have hA : |R.toFun x| ≤ F.tiny := R.subnormal_bound x h
  have hB : |x| ≤ F.tiny := h
  have key : |R.toFun x - x| ≤ |R.toFun x| + |x| := by
    have hsplit : R.toFun x - x = R.toFun x + -x := by ring
    rw [hsplit]
    simpa using abs_add (R.toFun x) (-x)
  calc
    |R.toFun x - x| ≤ |R.toFun x| + |x| := key
    _ ≤ F.tiny + F.tiny := add_le_add hA hB
    _ = 2 * F.tiny := by ring

name: belowTiny_or_not
doc: 次正规区与正规范围的互补刻画（按幅度划分输入）：`|x| ≤ tiny` 或 `tiny < |x|`。
stmt: theorem belowTiny_or_not (F : FloatFormat) (x : ℝ) : BelowTiny F x ∨ ¬ BelowTiny F x
proof: em _

name: ieee_directed_down_error
doc:
**B16 主结果（定向单侧误差界）**：定向舍入的误差**单侧**成立——
`towardDown` 时 `0 ≤ x − round x ≤ eps|x| + tiny`（误差非负且被界住）；
`towardUp` 时 `0 ≤ round x − x ≤ eps|x| + tiny`；
`towardZero` 时 `|round x| ≤ |x|` 且 `|round x − x| ≤ eps|x| + tiny`。

即：**误差的符号是确定的**，且大小仍受 `err_bound` 控制。
这比双侧界 `|round x − x| ≤ eps|x| + tiny` **多出符号信息**——
对误差传播分析（如 `RealMixedPrecisionRounding` 的累加）是有用的结构。
stmt:
theorem ieee_directed_down_error (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEEDirected F m)
    (hm : m = .towardDown) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ x - R.toFun x ∧ x - R.toFun x ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny
proof:
by
  refine ⟨by linarith [R.down_le hm x], ?_⟩
  have h := R.err_bound x
  have hle : R.toFun x ≤ x := R.down_le hm x
                                                    
  have habs : |R.toFun x - x| = x - R.toFun x := by
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : R.toFun x - x ≤ 0)]
    ring
  linarith [h, habs ▸ h]

name: ieee_directed_up_error
doc:
**B16（向 +∞ 版的单侧误差界）**：`towardUp` 时
`0 ≤ round x − x ≤ eps|x| + tiny`。
stmt:
theorem ieee_directed_up_error (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEEDirected F m)
    (hm : m = .towardUp) (x : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ R.toFun x - x ∧ R.toFun x - x ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny
proof:
by
  refine ⟨by linarith [R.le_up hm x], ?_⟩
  have h := R.err_bound x
  have hge : x ≤ R.toFun x := R.le_up hm x
  have habs : |R.toFun x - x| = R.toFun x - x :=
    abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ R.toFun x - x)
  linarith [h, habs ▸ h]

name: ieee_directed_zero
doc:
**B16（向零版）**：`towardZero` 时 `|round x| ≤ |x|`，
且误差仍受双侧界 `|round x − x| ≤ eps|x| + tiny` 控制。
stmt:
theorem ieee_directed_zero (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEEDirected F m)
    (hm : m = .towardZero) (x : ℝ) :
    |R.toFun x| ≤ |x| ∧ |R.toFun x - x| ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny
proof: ⟨R.abs_zero hm x, R.err_bound x⟩

name: ieee_directed_down_relative
doc:
**B16（单侧 ⟹ 相对界常数 1）**：`towardDown` 且在正规范围
（`tiny ≤ eps·|x|`）时，`0 ≤ x − round x ≤ 2·eps·|x|`
——与双侧版 `ieee_relative_error_bound` 同常数（因为那里也把 `tiny` 吸收进相对项），
但**额外给出非负性**，这是单侧结构独有的信息。
stmt:
theorem ieee_directed_down_relative (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEEDirected F m)
    (hm : m = .towardDown) {x : ℝ} (hr : InNormalRange F x) :
    0 ≤ x - R.toFun x ∧ x - R.toFun x ≤ 2 * F.eps * |x|
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := ieee_directed_down_error F m R hm x
  refine ⟨h0, ?_⟩
  have h2 : F.tiny ≤ F.eps * |x| := hr
  calc x - R.toFun x ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny := h1
    _ ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.eps * |x| := by linarith
    _ = 2 * F.eps * |x| := by ring

name: binaryFormat_eps_pos
doc: **B16 主结果（`eps` 由位宽推导，且为正）**：`eps = 2^(1−p) > 0`。
stmt: theorem binaryFormat_eps_pos (B : BinaryFormat) : 0 < B.eps
proof: zpow_pos (by norm_num) _

name: binaryFormat_tiny_pos
doc: **B16 主结果（`tiny` 由位宽推导，且为正）**：`tiny = 2^(1−emax) > 0`。
stmt: theorem binaryFormat_tiny_pos (B : BinaryFormat) : 0 < B.tiny
proof: zpow_pos (by norm_num) _

name: binaryFormat_eps_le_half
stmt: theorem binaryFormat_eps_le_half (B : BinaryFormat) : B.eps ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
by
  unfold BinaryFormat.eps
  have h : (1 : ℤ) - (B.p : ℤ) ≤ -1 := by
    have : (2 : ℤ) ≤ (B.p : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast B.hp
    linarith
  calc (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℤ) - (B.p : ℤ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (-1 : ℤ) :=
        zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) h
    _ = 1 / 2 := by norm_num

name: binaryFormat_tiny_le_one
stmt: theorem binaryFormat_tiny_le_one (B : BinaryFormat) : B.tiny ≤ 1
proof:
by
  unfold BinaryFormat.tiny
  have h : (1 : ℤ) - (B.emax : ℤ) ≤ 0 := by
    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ (B.emax : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast B.hemax
    linarith
  calc (2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℤ) - (B.emax : ℤ)) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (0 : ℤ) :=
        zpow_le_zpow_right₀ (by norm_num) h
    _ = 1 := by norm_num

name: binary64_eps_le_binary32_eps
doc:
**B16：双精度比单精度更精细**（`eps` 更小）：`binary64.eps ≤ binary32.eps`，

name: binary32_expBits

**B16 验证（binary32 的指数位宽）**：`emax = 128 = 2^7` ⟹ `log2 128 + 1 = 8` 位指数

  have h : binary32.emax = 2 ^ 7 := rfl
  rw [h, Nat.log2_two_pow]

name: ieeeToRoundOp_err_bound
doc: **`RoundOp` 第一条字段被满足**：`|round x − x| ≤ eps·|x| + tiny`。
stmt:
theorem ieeeToRoundOp_err_bound (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F m) (x : ℝ) :
    |(ieeeToRoundOp F m R).toFun x - x| ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny
proof: R.err_bound x

name: ieee_satisfies_roundOp
doc:
**兼容定理（核心）**：`IEEERound` 的实例**逐条满足** `RoundOp` 的两条字段
（`err_bound` 与 `idem`）——这是本文件与既有抽象层的桥。
stmt:
theorem ieee_satisfies_roundOp (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F m) :
    (∀ x : ℝ, |(ieeeToRoundOp F m R).toFun x - x| ≤ F.eps * |x| + F.tiny)
      ∧ (∀ x : ℝ, (ieeeToRoundOp F m R).toFun ((ieeeToRoundOp F m R).toFun x)
          = (ieeeToRoundOp F m R).toFun x)
proof: ⟨ieeeToRoundOp_err_bound F m R, ieeeToRoundOp_idem F m R⟩

name: ieee_format_error_bound
doc: **既有定理在 IEEE 语义下原样可用（1）**：`RealFloatFormat.format_error_bound`。
stmt:
theorem ieee_format_error_bound (F : FloatFormat) (m : RoundMode) (R : IEEERound F m) (x : ℝ) :

name: clampTo_abs_le
doc: 饱和结果的绝对值不超过 `M`（`M ≥ 0`）。
stmt: theorem clampTo_abs_le (M x : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) : |clampTo M x| ≤ M
proof:
by
  rw [abs_le]
  constructor
  · simp only [clampTo]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  · simp only [clampTo]
    exact max_le (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _)

name: clampTo_eq_self
doc: 未溢出（`|x| ≤ M`）时饱和不改变输入。
stmt: theorem clampTo_eq_self (M x : ℝ) (_hM : 0 ≤ M) (hx : |x| ≤ M) : clampTo M x = x
proof:
by
  have h1 : -M ≤ x := (abs_le.mp hx).1
  have h2 : x ≤ M := (abs_le.mp hx).2
  simp only [clampTo]
  rw [min_eq_right h2, max_eq_right h1]

name: clampTo_idem
doc: 饱和幂等：`clamp (clamp x) = clamp x`。
stmt: theorem clampTo_idem (M x : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) : clampTo M (clampTo M x) = clampTo M x
proof: clampTo_eq_self M (clampTo M x) hM (clampTo_abs_le M x hM)

name: clampTo_mono
doc: 饱和单调。
stmt: theorem clampTo_mono (M : ℝ) : Monotone (clampTo M)
proof:
by
  intro a b hab
  simp only [clampTo]
  exact max_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_min le_rfl hab) (le_max_right _ _))

name: clampTo_no_overflow
doc: **饱和不溢出的充分必要条件**：`|clamp x| ≤ M`，故 `¬ fpOverflow M (clamp x)`。
stmt: theorem clampTo_no_overflow (M x : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) : ¬ fpOverflow M (clampTo M x)
proof: not_lt.mpr (clampTo_abs_le M x hM)

name: clampTo_error_le
doc:
**饱和误差**：`|clamp x − x| ≤ max 0 (|x| − M)`
——未溢出时为 0，溢出时恰为超出量（`M ≥ 0`）。
stmt:
theorem clampTo_error_le (M x : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    |clampTo M x - x| ≤ max 0 (|x| - M)
proof:
by
  by_cases hx : |x| ≤ M
  · rw [clampTo_eq_self M x hM hx, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  · rw [not_le] at hx
    rcases lt_abs.mp hx with h | h
    · have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by linarith
      have hclamp : clampTo M x = M := by
        simp only [clampTo]
        rw [min_eq_left (le_of_lt h), max_eq_right (by linarith)]
      rw [hclamp]
      have hval : |M - x| = |x| - M := by
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : M - x ≤ 0), abs_of_nonneg hx0]
        ring
      rw [hval]
      exact le_max_right _ _
    · have hxneg : x < 0 := by linarith
      have hclamp : clampTo M x = -M := by
        simp only [clampTo]
        rw [min_eq_right (by linarith : x ≤ M), max_eq_left (by linarith : x ≤ -M)]
      rw [hclamp]
      have hval : |-M - x| = |x| - M := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : 0 ≤ -M - x), abs_of_neg hxneg]
        ring
      rw [hval]
      exact le_max_right _ _

name: clampTo_ne_self_of_overflow
doc: 溢出输入在饱和约定下严格被改变（`clamp x ≠ x`）。
stmt:
theorem clampTo_ne_self_of_overflow (M x : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (h : fpOverflow M x) :
    clampTo M x ≠ x
proof:
by
  intro hc
  have hb : |clampTo M x| ≤ M := clampTo_abs_le M x hM
  rw [hc] at hb
  exact absurd hb (not_le.mpr h)

name: lora_edit_verdict

theorem lora_edit_verdict (A : E →L[ℝ] H) (B : H →L[ℝ] F) (c : ℝ) (x : E) (ε : ℝ)
    (hε : |c| * ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖x‖ ≤ ε) :
    ‖LoRAEdit A B c x‖ ≤ ε

name: lora_edit_constraint
stmt:
theorem lora_edit_constraint (W : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℝ) (x : E)
    (A : E →L[ℝ] H) (B : H →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (h0 : W x + b = 0) :
    |(W + LoRAEdit A B c) x + b| ≤ ‖W‖ * (|c| * ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖x‖) + |c| * ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖x‖
proof:
by
                                          
  calc
    |(W + LoRAEdit A B c) x + b| = |(W x + b) + LoRAEdit A B c x| := by
                                   
      have : (W + LoRAEdit A B c) x + b = (W x + b) + LoRAEdit A B c x := by
        simp [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
        abel
      rw [this]
    _ ≤ |W x + b| + |LoRAEdit A B c x| := abs_add _ _
    _ = |LoRAEdit A B c x| := by
      rw [h0]
      norm_num
    _ ≤ |c| * ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖x‖ := lora_edit_bound A B c x
    _ ≤ ‖W‖ * (|c| * ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖x‖) + |c| * ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖x‖ := by
                          
      have hw : 0 ≤ ‖W‖ * (|c| * ‖B‖ * ‖A‖ * ‖x‖) := by
        positivity
      linarith

end Lattice

name: loss_scaling_unscale
doc: 反缩放精确还原：`2^k · (g / 2^k) = g`。
stmt:
theorem loss_scaling_unscale (k : ℕ) (g : ℝ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (g / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) = g
proof:
by
  have hp : (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≠ 0 := by positivity
  exact mul_div_cancel₀ g hp

name: loss_scaling_bound
stmt:
theorem loss_scaling_bound (k : ℕ) (g M : ℝ) (h : |g| ≤ M / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) :
    |(2 : ℝ) ^ k * g| ≤ M
proof:
by
  have hp : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ k := by positivity
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hp)]
  calc
    (2 : ℝ) ^ k * |g| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ k * (M / (2 : ℝ) ^ k) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (le_of_lt hp)
    _ = M := mul_div_cancel₀ M (ne_of_gt hp)

name: accSum_succ_sub
doc:
累加误差的递归展开：第 `n+1` 步误差 = 本步舍入误差 + 前 `n` 步累积误差
（中间点插值）。
stmt:
lemma accSum_succ_sub (ad : FPAdder) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    accSum ad (n + 1) x - ∑ k in Finset.range (n + 1), x k
      = (ad.toFun (accSum ad n x) (x n) - (accSum ad n x + x n))
        + (accSum ad n x - ∑ k in Finset.range n, x k)
proof:
by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  simp [accSum]
  ring

name: accumulation_error_nonneg
doc: 累加误差的非负性：`0 ≤ 2·n·eps·M`（`0 ≤ eps`、`0 ≤ M`）。
stmt:
theorem accumulation_error_nonneg (ad : FPAdder) (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * ad.eps * M
proof:
by
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) := by linarith
  have h3 : 0 ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) * ad.eps := mul_nonneg h2 ad.eps_nonneg
  exact mul_nonneg h3 hM

name: mixed_layer_error_pointwise
doc:
全精度与混合精度前向之差的可加性读法（三角不等式的直接形式）：
`|mixed − full| ≤ Σᵢ |R(wᵢ) − wᵢ|·|xᵢ|`——逐元素舍入误差按输入幅度加权求和。
stmt:
theorem mixed_layer_error_pointwise {n : ℕ} (R : ℝ → ℝ) (w x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    |mixedForward R w x - fullForward w x|
      ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, |R (w i) - w i| * |x i|
proof:
by
  calc
    |mixedForward R w x - fullForward w x|
        = |∑ i : Fin n, (R (w i) * x i - w i * x i)| := by
          unfold mixedForward fullForward
          rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin n, |R (w i) * x i - w i * x i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ = ∑ i : Fin n, |R (w i) - w i| * |x i| := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          have hsplit : R (w i) * x i - w i * x i = (R (w i) - w i) * x i := by ring
          rw [hsplit, abs_mul]

name: one_le_prod_one_add
doc: **乘积杠杆引理**：每一步因子 `1 + es i ≥ 1` 时，乘积 `∏_{i<k}(1 + es i) ≥ 1`。
stmt:
lemma one_le_prod_one_add (es : ℕ → ℝ) (hes : ∀ i, 0 ≤ es i) (n : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ ∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i)
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
      have hb : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + es n := by linarith [hes n]
      calc (1 : ℝ) = 1 * 1 := by ring
        _ ≤ (∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i)) * (1 + es n) :=
            mul_le_mul ih hb (by norm_num) (le_trans (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1) ih)

name: prod_const_one_add
doc: 常因子乘积的幂形式：`∏_{i<k}(1 + eps) = (1 + eps)^k`。
stmt:
lemma prod_const_one_add (eps : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    ∏ _i in Finset.range n, (1 + eps) = (1 + eps) ^ n
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, pow_succ]

name: ieeeAccN_growth_error
doc:
**新内容：逐层单位舍入累加的增长与误差（联合归纳）**。若第 `i` 步舍入满足
纯相对界 `|R i y − y| ≤ es i·|y|`（`es i ≥ 0`），则
  增长：`|fl(Σ_{i<k} x_i)| ≤ (Σ_{i<k}|x_i|)·∏_{i<k}(1+es i)`；
  误差：`|fl(Σ_{i<k} x_i) − Σ_{i<k} x_i| ≤ (Σ_{i<k}|x_i|)·(∏_{i<k}(1+es i) − 1)`。
两者在同一次归纳中给出（误差步需要增长步的中间估计）。
stmt:
theorem ieeeAccN_growth_error {R : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ} {es : ℕ → ℝ} (hes : ∀ i, 0 ≤ es i)
    (hR : ∀ (i : ℕ) (y : ℝ), |R i y - y| ≤ es i * |y|) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    (|ieeeAccN R n x| ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * ∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i))
      ∧ (|ieeeAccN R n x - ∑ i in Finset.range n, x i|
          ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i|) * (∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i) - 1))
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      constructor <;> simp [ieeeAccN]
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨ihg, ihe⟩ := ih
      set Pn : ℝ := ∏ i in Finset.range n, (1 + es i) with hPn
      set An : ℝ := ∑ i in Finset.range n, |x i| with hAn_def
      have hPn_ge : 1 ≤ Pn := by rw [hPn]; exact one_le_prod_one_add es hes n
      have hPn_succ : ∏ i in Finset.range (n + 1), (1 + es i) = Pn * (1 + es n) := by
        rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ← hPn]
      have hAn_succ : (∑ i in Finset.range (n + 1), |x i|) = An + |x n| := by
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ← hAn_def]
      have hRabs : |R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n)| ≤ (1 + es n) * (|ieeeAccN R n x| + |x n|) := by
        have hy := hR n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n)
        have htri : |ieeeAccN R n x + x n| ≤ |ieeeAccN R n x| + |x n| := abs_add _ _
                                                                           
                                                               
        have htri2 : |R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n)|
            ≤ |R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n) - (ieeeAccN R n x + x n)| + |ieeeAccN R n x + x n| := by
          have h := abs_add (R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n) - (ieeeAccN R n x + x n))
            (ieeeAccN R n x + x n)
          have hid : R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n) - (ieeeAccN R n x + x n)
              + (ieeeAccN R n x + x n) = R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n) := by ring
          rwa [hid] at h
        calc
          |R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n)|
              ≤ |R n (ieeeAccN R n x + x n) - (ieeeAccN R n x

name: ieeeAccR_eq_accN
doc: 单格式累加与逐层累加在常误差函数下的相容：`ieeeAccR R = ieeeAccN (fun _ => R)`。
stmt:
lemma ieeeAccR_eq_accN (R : ℝ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ieeeAccR R n x = ieeeAccN (fun _ : ℕ => R) n x
proof:
by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [ieeeAccR, ieeeAccN]
  | succ n ih => simp only [ieeeAccR, ieeeAccN, ih]
